Choose a class and begin climbing. Each floor offers doors: combat, an event, a chest, an elite, a shop, or rest. In combat, read the enemy intent and choose one move. Hold a move to see its description.

Every tenth floor brings a boss. After victory, descend with all your shards or climb higher. Defeat still preserves some shards. Buy permanent upgrades in the Stairway Workshop between attempts.

Clearing the Spire unlocks the next height: earlier restrictions remain, a new one appears, and shards increase. Beyond floor thirty, the climb is endless. The Daily Tower uses a shared seed and a special rule.

Trips double shards. A long-trip chest awaits at the start of the next flight. Fresh Legs spends step energy: the first rest of a flight heals fully. Daily bets use shards.
